summary.text: Stephen Boyd is a Republican state representative from Merrimack District 10 who has served since December 7, 2022, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, after advancing from the September 8, 2026 primary.

paragraphs.text: Boyd lives in Hooksett, New Hampshire, and serves in the U.S. Army, according to Ballotpedia.
He earned a B.S. in organizational management, and his career experience includes working as a test engineer for medical device companies.
Ballotpedia lists him as assigned to the Labor, Industrial and Rehabilitative Services Committee in the 2021-2022 and 2023-2024 sessions.
